body:
Worth discovering, and seeing in a photograph … here:

 http://gmdevotionals.wordpress.com/2012/02/11/how-many-kingdoms/

A reader sent this in:

 Your books have changed my life, I met you at Wild Goose, I could tell you all the stuff you’re used to hearing, etc. And it would all be true.

But I just wanted to share this with you. At our house-church, neo-monastic community we are studying The Secret Message of Jesus. It is opening eyes, challenging us and doing all the things I’m sure you hoped it would do when you wrote it.

Here is a blog post relating to our study that I think you will appreciate: http://gmdevotionals.wordpress.com/2012/02/11/how-many-kingdoms/

 Thanks for the encouragement! And thanks for introducing me to August Landmesser.
